modes.what: lemonfiber manages the containers already here and reads their configuration. Nothing is recreated and nothing is moved.
lemonfiber stands up its own stack and copies indexers, root folders and monitored items across through each service's own API. The existing stack is left running.
lemonfiber runs on ports nothing else is using, alongside the setup already here, so it can be tried without committing to it.
lemonfiber stands up a clean stack and stops the old one. Nothing of it is deleted, so it can be started again.

not_carried.because: they are scoring rules particular to your library, and lemonfiber sets its own from the quality preset you choose
seed ratios, limits and priorities are set against indexers lemonfiber does not know you hold accounts with
a connect script runs a program on your machine, and carrying one across would run somebody's program somewhere it was never pointed at
not_carried.what: scripts hooked into a curator's events

not_carried.because: they live in the media server's own database rather than in the wiring lemonfiber sets up, and nothing here reads them
